# 🚀 Deployment Checklist

- [ ] Intended Streamlit script selected.
- [ ] Python runtime documented.
- [ ] requirements.txt resolved successfully.
- [ ] Build/start logs reviewed.
- [ ] Access/privacy settings reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets added to repository.
- [ ] Synthetic smoke inputs tested.
- [ ] No raw traceback or misleading output.
- [ ] Current algorithm limitations visible.
- [ ] Release commit recorded.
- [ ] Rollback process verified.

## Host-specific details
Provider, app URL, branch, entry point, runtime and owner. Do not place secret values here.
